description:
docs/concepts/guarantees.md lists agent claiming and coordination under what works without git, while the advisory-lease commands require a git repository and fail with a typed error (exit 10) outside one. The document's own multi-agent example uses a lease command.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The git-optional section distinguishes issue assignment (works without git) from advisory leases (require git, typed failure with exit 10)
- [hard] REQ-02: The requires-git list includes the lease commands
- [hard] REQ-03: Examples in the document are consistent with the stated requirements
title: Correct git-requirement claims in the guarantees doc
